      • It's Italia

        3.8
        (1k reviews)
        Patricia L.
        14 days ago

        I love the ambiance of this place but I've not had anything I would recommend. I recently just wanted a soup and I ordered the minestrone. The flavor was okay but the beans and pasta were undercooked. The vegetables were stringy and there was as no meat or meat flavor. Service was excellent.

        Perry’s - Novato

        3.4
        (219 reviews)
        Althea A.
        16 days ago

        Went for happy hour on a hot day as we know they have nice cold beers. Seems like every time we go, the bartenders there just don't cut it. Either not personable which doesn't make for a good atmosphere or super loud which also doesn't make for a comfortable experience. When we have to get their attention, when they see us come sit, to ask for a beer and they don't even greet us, just stand there, then they shouldn't be a bartender. Shame how the service has declined over the past year.

        Grazie Restaurant

        3.8
        (611 reviews)
        CJ R.
        18 days ago

        So refreshing to get wonderful service accompanied by great food and a warm welcome from the staff! We just left Finnegan's restaurant right down the street because of the terrible service we received when we sat down from our server. We walked to Grazie restaurant, had steak and eggs and cappuccinos, and the manager and server were wonderful. Friendly, welcoming, attentive, excellent service and food all around. Will definitely be back!

        Madera

        3.5
        (1k reviews)
        M.D. L.
        22 days ago

        The location is nearly perfect if you are driving from San Francisco and a short distance from Highway 280. This is an excellent place for business luncheons or a meal in a lovely setting. I give high marks for the menu because you can find what appeals to most based on dietary needs and the food is sourced locally and sustainably. The Manresa sourdough bread with Strauss Family Creamery tarragon butter is a must. The salads are inventive and you can add a protein even Mt Lassen trout which is delicious and sustainable.

        I am not one to quibble about size and portions but the scaling back is noticeable. The only complaint I have is the cost of iced tea at $7. It was replenished without the server asking or pouring it from a pitcher so your conversation is not interrupted. However, you pay for refills as a full glass. In the end, you pay for the quality and sourcing of the food and the excellent service in an ideal location including parking.

        Ocean Terrace

        3.0
        (123 reviews)
        David K.
        22 days ago

        Walked up at 11:50 for lunch today. There were at least 8 tables open near the bar and 15 tables open near the course. The man asked if we were staying in the hotel, when we said no, he said they couldn't get us a table for 30 plus minutes. I looked around at all the empty tables and said goodbye. Why run off a paying customer??? No customer service! Go elswhere

        Beso Bistro And Wine Bar

        3.9
        (376 reviews)
        Mark F.
        22 days ago

        Service was great and atmosphere good.


        The food quality has dipped since last visit. I ordered a filet mignon cooked medium. It came out cooked inconsistent. About 20 percent of the steak was cooked well done and grey. The rest was pretty much cooked medium rare - almost raw. How is this even possible? Is the grill not even temperature?


        Worst off the steak was low quality. Very thin and with fat and connective tissue. Very hard to cut. When I order a filet mignon I expect buttery smooth texture. Not texture that you get from cheap cuts of steak. Also, no seasoning applied. Very bland flavor.


        I know they can do better cause they have in the past. Maybe this is the result of trying to save money and maximize profit by reducing quality?


        Too bad cause they still have positives. But if the food quality stays this low it is not worth it. Hope this was just an off night...

        The Conservatory

        3.3
        (378 reviews)
        Talat H.
        23 days ago

        Food was very underwhelming and the service was terrible. Very disappointing because our past experiences were very good. Could Memorial Day have something to do with it?

        Warehouse Cafe

        4.0
        (421 reviews)
        jake c.
        24 days ago

        Love the bar and vibes, but daaaaang, the food? Not impressed. I heard that the new owner raised prices and may be trying to cut costs, but let's be real: if you are advertising a polish sandwich, you shouldn't be serving a hot dog on wonder break roll.
        Service is great, people are friendly, music is good, but come on, you can't skimp on food when you're charging that much. $16 for a soggy bottom hot dog.

        Michael Warring

        4.7
        (429 reviews)
        Angad S.
        24 days ago

        Considering it was just the chef and his ?wife working the entire restaurant it was an impressive dinner. Food was quite good, good range on the menu, good presentation, and impressive for the price, wine pairing was decent.
        Ambiance was ok, a smaller restaurant and a bit run down, not polished as one would expect from a starred restaurant but again this is much cheaper so I give that a pass bc the food was great.
        Service was ok, again not starred and cheaper. For example towards the last few glasses of wine the glass was given without even saying what it was (which I can obv look it up but is a nice touch when someone explains how the chef intends to eat the course or where the wine is from). I do understand that it was prob bc it was just the chef and his wife working so they certainly can't be doing the level of service (or charge for that) that a starred restaurant offers.
        I still highly recommend this restaurant for the food and the price point. I've certainly had worse for more (including at starred restaurants)

        Timber & Tide

        4.4
        (7 reviews)
        Diane B.Elite 26
        25 days ago

        Stopped by for lunch while I was getting my car serviced. It was incredibly difficult to find in this Biotech land. There is NO signage until your in the door. Parking in the lot is pretty limited, and we were not at all sure if we could park in another nearby lot without being ticketed. All of the surfaces are hard and the ceilings are very tall, so as it fills up it's impossible to have a conversation unless you yell.

        I had CHICKEN BACON CHOPPED SALAD | $18
        roasted halal chicken, apple wood smoked bacon, cherry tomatoes, red onion, hass avocado, house-made herb ranch: 3 stars.
        It was large and every thing looked fresh, except the chicken was a little dry. The dressing, which was virtually flavorless, and only the middle of the lettuce was dressed, none of the other ingredients. This meant when you toss it up to eat it, there's not nearly enough.

        T had the CHICKEN PESTO PANINO | $16
        roasted mary's organic chicken breast, provolone, sundried tomato spread, basil pesto, miche bread, green salad. 3 stars.
        He said it was tasty, but the roll could not stand up to that load. His side salad had no dressing at all.

        Prices seemed fair, service was good enough, except I never saw a table being washed down after it was bussed.

        Food: 24/40
        service: 15/20
        atm/Intangibles: 15/20
        Value: 16/20
        Overall: 70/100
